plugin.name: PotAndPapers
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Scribe and brew profiles in a miniwindow: one command makes a batch
plugin.description:
PotAndPapers - a scroll scriber and potion brewer.
pnp config the profile window (click any value to change it) pnp help every command
Each profile is a command of your own, scribe or brew, a spell, how many spells go on one scroll or potion (1x to 4x), how many to make, a nickname, and what to run when the batch is done (sleep by default; pnp after <command> changes the default for new profiles).
sinc make the profile's usual number sinc 8 make 8
A batch is one command. A session is every batch until an hour has passed since the last scribe or brew.

trigger.match: ^You have imbued a new spell to the scroll\.
^The magic enchantment has failed \-\-\- the scroll vanishes\.$
^You lost your concentration while trying to (scribe|brew) the new magic\.$
^You have imbued a new spell to the potion\.
^The magic enchantment has failed \-\-\- the potion vanishes\.$

muclient.script:
require "aardwolf_colors" require "serialize" pcall (require, "themed_miniwindows")
local VERSION = "1.4" local PNAME = "PotAndPapers" local GMCP_ID = "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264" local ALCH_ID = "f7d314c12df89a4093baedfa" -- Nok3_Alchemist
-- Colour scheme local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- x099 brackets, dim text local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- x045 names local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- W message text local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- x048 values, commands, clickables local CLR_BAD = "#FF5F5F" -- x203 failures
local IDLE_ECHO = 600 -- seconds after a batch with nothing new: echo the session so far local SESSION_GAP = 3600 -- seconds after the last spell: the session closes local WATCH_SECS = 12 -- a spell with no result by now: the batch has stalled local MAX_RETRY = 10 -- lost concentration this many times in a row: stop
-- what each kind of profile does local KIND = { scribe = { label = "Scribe", verb = "scribe", item = "scroll", items = "scrolls", blank = "blank scroll ", group = "pnp_scribe" }, brew = { label = "Brew", verb = "brew", item = "potion", items = "potions", blank = "empty vial ", group = "pnp_brew" }, }
local KNOWN_SPELLS = { "curse", "incomplete healing", "party heal", "regeneration", "remove curse", "reverse align" }
-- the default nickname for a spell local NICKS = { ["incomplete healing"] = "Incomp", ["reverse align"] = "Reverse", ["curse"] = "Curse", ["party heal"] = "PartyHeal", ["regeneration"] = "Regen", ["remove curse"] = "RemCurse", }
-- commands that must never become a profile local RESERVED = {} for w in ([[pnp scribe brew sleepx wakex sleep wake get put hold rem remove wear look say quaff recite cast give drop sac sell buy list help where who]]):gmatch ("%S+") do RESERVED[w] = true end
-- what Nok3_Alchemist answers to local ALCH_CMDS = {} for w in ([[alch binc brc breg bscroll bvial qinc qrc qreg sinc scur srev sph sreg rinc rcur rrev rph rreg]]):gmatch ("%S+") do ALCH_CMDS[w] = true end
-- =========================================================== -- Timers: DoAfterSpecial refuses anything under 0.1s and says -- nothing, so every timer goes through here. -- =========================================================== function PnP_After (delay, code) if not delay or delay < 0.1 then delay = 0.1 end local rc = DoAfterSpecial (delay, code, 12) if rc ~= 0 then ColourNote (CLR_BAD, "", "[" .. PNAME .. "] A timer was refused (code " .. tostring (rc) .. "): " .. tostring (code)) end end
-- =========================================================== -- Echoes -- =========================================================== local function esc (s) return (tostring (s == nil and "" or s):gsub ("@", "@@")) end local function cnote (s) AnsiNote (stylesToANSI (ColoursToStyles (s))) end local function note (msg) cnote ("@x099[@x045" .. PNAME .. "@x099]@w " .. msg) end local function warn (msg) cnote ("@x099[@x045" .. PNAME .. "@x099]@w @x203" .. msg .. "@w") end local function hi (s) return "@x048" .. esc (s) .. "@w" end local function nm (s) return "@x045" .. esc (s) .. "@w" end local function trim (s) return (tostring (s or ""):gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "")) end
local function pct (made, tried) if not tried or tried <= 0 then return "-" end return string.format ("%.1f%%", made * 100 / tried) end
local function auto_nick (spell) spell = tostring (spell or ""):lower () if NICKS[spell] then return NICKS[spell] end local w = spell:match ("^(%a+)") or "Spell" return w:sub (1, 1):upper () .. w:sub (2) end
local function kind (p) return KIND[p.kind] or KIND.scribe end -- 3xIncomp (the window's Name column, beside its own Type column) local function short_label (p) return tostring (p.per) .. "x" .. tostring (p.nick) end -- Scribe 3xIncomp / Brew 3xIncomp (every echo) local function label (p) return kind (p).label .. " " .. short_label (p) end
-- =========================================================== -- Saved data -- =========================================================== local function default_data () return { bag = "", next_id = 3, default_after = "sleep", profiles = { { id = 1, cmd = "sinc", kind = "scribe", spell = "incomplete healing", nick = "Incomp", per = 3, total = 8, after = "sleep", made = 0, tried = 0 }, { id = 2, cmd = "sinc2", kind = "scribe", spell = "incomplete healing", nick = "Incomp", per = 2, total = 8, after = "sleep", made = 0, tried = 0 }, }, spells = {}, history = {}, font = "Consolas", fontsize = 12, winheight = 600, } end
local function load_data () local d local v = GetVariable ("data") if v and v ~= "" then local f = loadstring ("return " .. v) if f then local ok, t = pcall (f) if ok and type (t) == "table" then d = t end end if not d then SetVariable ("data_unreadable", v) -- kept, in case it can be rescued by hand ColourNote (CLR_BAD, "", "[" .. PNAME .. "] Saved profiles could not be read - starting from defaults.") end end if not d then d = default_data () -- borrow the bag Nok3_Alchemist already knows local a = GetPluginVariable (ALCH_ID, "alch_settings") local bag = type (a) == "string" and a:match ('bag%s*=%s*"([^"]*)"') if bag and bag ~= "" then d.bag = bag end end d.bag = d.bag or "" d.profiles = d.profiles or {} d.spells = d.spells or {} d.history = d.history or {} d.font = d.font or "Consolas" d.fontsize = tonumber (d.fontsize) or 12 d.winheight = tonumber (d.winheight) or 600 local top = 0 for _, p in ipairs (d.profiles) do p.made = tonumber (p.made) or 0 p.tried = tonumber (p.tried) or 0 p.per = tonumber (p.per) or 1 p.total = tonumber (p.total) or 1 p.after = p.after or "" p.kind = KIND[p.kind] and p.kind or "scribe" -- 1.0 profiles were all scribing p.nick = (p.nick and p.nick ~= "") and p.nick or auto_nick (p.spell) if (p.id or 0) > top then top = p.id end end d.next_id = math.max (tonumber (d.next_id) or 1, top + 1) -- the after command new profiles get (1.4); data from before 1.4 that -- already used sleepx keeps it as the default if type (d.default_after) ~= "string" then d.default_after = "sleep" for _, p in ipairs (d.profiles) do if p.after == "sleepx" then d.default_after = "sleepx" end end end return d end
local data = load_data ()
-- no_flush: from OnPluginSaveState, which is already writing the file local function save (no_flush) SetVariable ("data", serialize.save_simple (data)) if not no_flush then pcall (SaveState) end end
local function by_id (id) for i, p in ipairs (data.profiles) do if p.id == id then return p, i end end end
local function by_cmd (c) c = trim (c):lower () for i, p in ipairs (data.profiles) do if p.cmd == c then return p, i end end end
-- every spell on offer: the built-in ones plus any added local function all_spells () local seen, t = {}, {} for _, s in ipairs (KNOWN_SPELLS) do seen[s] = true; t[#t + 1] = s end for _, s in ipairs (data.spells) do if not seen[s] then seen[s] = true; t[#t + 1] = s end end table.sort (t) return t end
local function remember_spell (s) for _, k in ipairs (KNOWN_SPELLS) do if k == s then return end end for _, k in ipairs (data.spells) do if k == s then return end end data.spells[#data.spells + 1] = s end
-- a new spell for a profile: the nickname follows, unless it was set by hand local function set_spell (p, s) if p.nick == auto_nick (p.spell) then p.nick = auto_nick (s) end p.spell = s remember_spell (s) end
-- =========================================================== -- State -- =========================================================== local run = nil -- the batch in progress local run_gen = 0 local idle_gen = 0 -- voids the session timers when a new batch starts local gstate = 0 -- GMCP char.status state local win_refresh -- the window, defined below
-- =========================================================== -- Sessions -- =========================================================== local function sorted_per (s) local t = {} for _, e in pairs (s.per or {}) do t[#t + 1] = e end table.sort (t, function (a, b) return tostring (a.label) < tostring (b.label) end) return t end
local function session_echo (s, head) note (head .. " " .. hi (s.made) .. " made / " .. hi (s.tried) .. " tried " .. hi (pct (s.made, s.tried)) .. " (since " .. os.date ("%H:%M", s.start) .. ")") for _, e in ipairs (sorted_per (s)) do cnote (string.format (" %s %s made / %s tried %s", nm (e.label or e.cmd), hi (e.made), hi (e.tried), hi (pct (e.made, e.tried)))) end end
local function close_session (quiet) local s = data.session if not s then return end data.session = nil if (s.tried or 0) > 0 then table.insert (data.history, 1, s) while #data.history > 30 do table.remove (data.history) end end save () if not quiet and (s.tried or 0) > 0 then session_echo (s, "Session closed:") note ("The next batch starts a new session.") end end
local function session_expired () local s = data.session return s ~= nil and not run and (os.time () - (s.last or 0)) >= SESSION_GAP end
-- the open session, closing it (with its echo) if its hour is up local function current_session () if session_expired () then close_session (false) end return data.session end
local function open_session () if session_expired () then close_session (false) end local now = os.time () if not data.session then data.session = { start = now, last = now, made = 0, tried = 0, per = {} } end data.session.last = now return data.session end
-- after a batch: echo at 10 minutes, close at the hour -- no_echo: after a reload, where the 10 minute echo may already have been given local function arm_session_timers (no_echo) local s = data.session if not s then return end idle_gen = idle_gen + 1 local left = (s.last + SESSION_GAP) - os.time () if not no_echo and left > IDLE_ECHO then PnP_After (IDLE_ECHO, "PnP_IdleEcho (" .. idle_gen .. ")") end PnP_After (math.max (1, left + 1), "PnP_SessionEnd (" .. idle_gen .. ")") end
-- pnp end / [end session]: close it now instead of waiting for the hour local function end_session () if run then warn ("A batch is running - " .. hi ("pnp stop") .. " @x203it first, then end the session.") return end if not data.session then note ("No session is open.") return end idle_gen = idle_gen + 1 -- its 10 minute echo and hour close are void now if (data.session.tried or 0) == 0 then data.session = nil save () note ("Session ended (nothing was made in it).") else close_session (false) end if win_refresh then win_refresh () end end
function PnP_IdleEcho (g) if g ~= idle_gen or run or not data.session then return end local s = data.session session_echo (s, "Session so far:") local mins = math.max (1, math.floor (((s.last + SESSION_GAP) - os.time ()) / 60)) note ("A batch in the next " .. hi (mins .. " min") .. " adds to this session.") end
function PnP_SessionEnd (g) if g ~= idle_gen or run then return end if session_expired () then close_session (false) if win_refresh then win_refresh () end end end
-- =========================================================== -- The batch -- =========================================================== local function keyword () return run.k.item .. " " .. (run.p.spell:gsub ("%s+", "")) end
local function arm_watch () run.step = run.step + 1 PnP_After (WATCH_SECS, string.format ("PnP_Watch (%d, %d)", run.gen, run.step)) end
local function add_spell () run.session.last = os.time () SendNoEcho (run.k.verb .. " '" .. run.p.spell .. "'") arm_watch () end
local function start_item () run.spells = 0 SendNoEcho ("get '" .. run.k.blank .. "' " .. data.bag) SendNoEcho ("hold '" .. run.k.blank .. "'") add_spell () end
local function record (ok) local p, s = run.p, run.session local n = ok and 1 or 0 run.tried, run.made = run.tried + 1, run.made + n p.tried, p.made = p.tried + 1, p.made + n s.tried, s.made = s.tried + 1, s.made + n s.per = s.per or {} local k = "p" .. p.id local e = s.per[k] or { made = 0, tried = 0 } s.per[k] = e e.cmd, e.label, e.kind, e.spell, e.per = p.cmd, label (p), p.kind, p.spell, p.per e.tried, e.made = e.tried + 1, e.made + n save () end
local function batch_echo (ok) local s = run.session note (string.format ("%s %s Batch %s %s Session %s made %s", nm (label (run.p)), ok and "@x048made@w " or "@x203failed@w", hi (run.made .. "/" .. run.target), hi (pct (run.made, run.tried)), hi (s.made), hi (pct (s.made, s.tried)))) end
local function finish_batch (why) local b = run run = nil run_gen = run_gen + 1 EnableTriggerGroup ("pnp_scribe", false) EnableTriggerGroup ("pnp_brew", false) EnableTriggerGroup ("pnp_retry", false)
local word = (why == "done" and "done") or (why == "stalled" and "stalled") or "stopped" note (string.format ("Batch %s: %s %s made of %s, %s tried %s", word, nm (label (b.p)), hi (b.made), hi (b.target), hi (b.tried), hi (pct (b.made, b.tried)))) if why ~= "done" and b.spells > 0 then note ("The " .. b.k.item .. " in your hand has " .. hi (b.spells .. " of " .. b.p.per) .. " spells on it.") end save () arm_session_timers () if win_refresh then win_refresh () end if why ~= "stopped" and b.p.after ~= "" then note ("Running " .. hi (b.p.after) .. ".") Execute (b.p.after) end end
local function start_batch (p, n) if run then warn ("A batch of " .. nm (label (run.p)) .. " @x203is running - " .. hi ("pnp stop") .. " @x203first.") return end if data.bag == "" then warn ("Set the bag first: click Bag in " .. hi ("pnp config") .. "@x203, or " .. hi ("pnp bag <id>") .. "@x203.") return end n = math.floor (tonumber (n) or p.total) if n < 1 or n > 999 then warn ("Make between 1 and 999.") return end local k = kind (p) if gstate == 9 then warn ("You look asleep - the " .. k.verb .. " will fail until you wake.") end if gstate == 8 then warn ("You are fighting - the " .. k.verb .. " may fail.") end
idle_gen = idle_gen + 1 -- this batch belongs to the open session: no echo, no close local s = open_session () run_gen = run_gen + 1 run = { p = p, k = k, target = n, made = 0, tried = 0, spells = 0, step = 0, retries = 0, gen = run_gen, session = s } save () EnableTriggerGroup ("pnp_scribe", p.kind == "scribe") EnableTriggerGroup ("pnp_brew", p.kind == "brew") EnableTriggerGroup ("pnp_retry", true) note (string.format ("Batch: %s x %s (%s %s, %s), then %s", hi (n), nm (label (p)), k.verb, esc (p.spell), hi (p.cmd), p.after ~= "" and hi (p.after) or "nothing")) start_item () if win_refresh then win_refresh () end end
local function stop_batch () if not run then note ("No batch is running.") return end finish_batch ("stopped") end
-- "You lost your concentration while trying to scribe the new magic." -- Nothing was added and nothing was lost: send the same spell again. function PnP_Retry (name, line, w) if not run then return end if w and w[1] and w[1] ~= run.k.verb then return end -- the other kind's line run.step = run.step + 1 -- the watchdog for that spell is answered run.retries = run.retries + 1 if run.retries > MAX_RETRY then warn ("Lost concentration " .. MAX_RETRY .. " times in a row - stopping.") finish_batch ("stalled") return end add_spell () end
function PnP_Success () if not run then return end run.step = run.step + 1 -- the watchdog for that spell is answered run.retries = 0 run.spells = run.spells + 1 if run.spells < run.p.per then add_spell () if win_refresh then win_refresh () end return end local kw = keyword () SendNoEcho ("rem '" .. kw .. "'") SendNoEcho ("put '" .. kw .. "' " .. data.bag) run.spells = 0 record (true) batch_echo (true) if run.made >= run.target then finish_batch ("done") else start_item () if win_refresh then win_refresh () end end end
function PnP_Fail () if not run then return end run.step = run.step + 1 run.retries = 0 run.spells = 0 record (false) batch_echo (false) start_item () if win_refresh then win_refresh () end end
function PnP_Watch (g, step) if not run or run.gen ~= g or run.step ~= step then return end warn ("No result from " .. run.k.verb .. " in " .. WATCH_SECS .. "s - out of mana or " .. (run.p.kind == "brew" and "empty vials" or "blank scrolls") .. "?") finish_batch ("stalled") end
-- =========================================================== -- Profile commands (real aliases, one per profile) -- =========================================================== local alias_names = {} local ALIAS_FLAGS = 1 + 32 + 128 + 16384 -- enabled, ignore case, regexp, temporary
local function register_aliases () for _, n in ipairs (alias_names) do DeleteAlias (n) end alias_names = {} for _, p in ipairs (data.profiles) do local name = "pnp_run_" .. p.id local rc = AddAlias (name, "^" .. p.cmd .. "(?:\\s+(\\d+))?\\s*$", "", ALIAS_FLAGS, "PnP_AliasRun") if rc == 0 then alias_names[#alias_names + 1] = name else warn ("Could not make the command " .. hi (p.cmd) .. " @x203(error " .. tostring (rc) .. ").") end end end
function PnP_AliasRun (name, line, w) local id = tonumber (name:match ("^pnp_run_(%d+)$") or "") local p = id and by_id (id) if not p then return end start_batch (p, tonumber (w[1] or "")) end
function PnP_AlchCheck () if not (IsPluginInstalled (ALCH_ID) and GetPluginInfo (ALCH_ID, 17)) then return end local clash = {} for _, p in ipairs (data.profiles) do if ALCH_CMDS[p.cmd] then clash[#clash + 1] = p.cmd end end if #clash == 0 then return end warn ("Nok3_Alchemist is loaded and also answers " .. hi (table.concat (clash, ", ")) .. "@x203. Remove Alchemist from your plugins, or rename those profiles.") end
-- =========================================================== -- Asking for values (dialogs) -- =========================================================== local function check_cmd (c, except_id) c = trim (c):lower () if not c:match ("^%a%w*$") or #c < 2 or #c > 15 then return nil, "A command is 2 to 15 letters or digits, starting with a letter." end if RESERVED[c] then return nil, "'" .. c .. "' is already a game or plugin command." end local p = by_cmd (c) if p and p.id ~= except_id then return nil, "Another profile already uses '" .. c .. "'." end return c end
local function check_spell (v) v = trim (v):lower ():gsub ("%s+", " ") if v == "" then return nil, "Give a spell name." end if v:find ("[';@]") then return nil, "A spell name cannot contain ' ; or @" end return v end
local function check_nick (v) v = trim (v) if not v:match ("^%a[%w]*$") or #v > 15 then return nil, "A nickname is up to 15 letters or digits, no spaces, starting with a letter." end return v end
local function ask_cmd (default, except_id) local v = utils.inputbox ("Command for this profile (type it, with an optional number, to make a batch):", PNAME, default or "") if not v then return nil end local c, err = check_cmd (v, except_id) if not c then utils.msgbox (err, PNAME, "ok", "!", 1) return nil end return c end
local function ask_kind (default) local t = { "Scribe - scrolls", "Brew - potions" } local k = utils.listbox ("Scribe scrolls or brew potions?", PNAME, t, default == "brew" and 2 or 1) if not k then return nil end return k == 2 and "brew" or "scribe" end
-- the list, plus a way to type a spell that is not on it yet local function ask_spell (default) local spells = all_spells () local t = {} for i, s in ipairs (spells) do t[i] = s end local NEW = #spells + 1 t[NEW] = "+ Add a new spell (type its name)..." local dflt = NEW for i, s in ipairs (spells) do if s == default then dflt = i end end local k = utils.listbox ("Spell (pick one, or add a new one at the bottom):", PNAME, t, dflt) if not k then return nil end if k ~= NEW then return t[k] end local v = utils.inputbox ("Name of the spell (its full name, as you would cast it):", PNAME, "") if not v then return nil end local s, err = check_spell (v) if not s then utils.msgbox (err, PNAME, "ok", "!", 1) return nil end remember_spell (s) return s end
local function ask_per (default, what) local t = {} for i = 1, 4 do t[i] = i .. "x - " .. i .. " spell" .. (i > 1 and "s" or "") .. " per " .. what end return utils.listbox ("How many spells on each " .. what .. "?", PNAME, t, default or 3) end
local function ask_total (default, what) local v = utils.inputbox ("How many " .. what .. " to make when no number is typed (1 to 999)?", PNAME, tostring (default or 8)) if not v then return nil end local n = tonumber (trim (v)) if not n or n < 1 or n > 999 then utils.msgbox ("Give a number from 1 to 999.", PNAME, "ok", "!", 1) return nil end return math.floor (n) end
local function ask_after (default) local v = utils.inputbox ("Command to run when the batch is done (blank for nothing):", PNAME, default or "sleep") if not v then return nil end return trim (v) end
local function ask_nick (p) local v = utils.inputbox ("Nickname for echoes - it shows as " .. kind (p).label .. " " .. p.per .. "x<nickname>, e.g. " .. label (p) .. ".\nBlank goes back to the default (" .. auto_nick (p.spell) .. ").", PNAME, p.nick) if not v then return nil end if trim (v) == "" then return auto_nick (p.spell) end local n, err = check_nick (v) if not n then utils.msgbox (err, PNAME, "ok", "!", 1) return nil end return n end
local function profile_line (p) local k = kind (p) return string.format ("%s (%s): %s %dx %s, makes %d, then %s.", nm (label (p)), hi (p.cmd), k.verb, p.per, esc (p.spell), p.total, p.after ~= "" and hi (p.after) or "nothing") end
local function new_profile () local c = ask_cmd ("", nil) if not c then return end local kd = ask_kind ("scribe") if not kd then return end local spell = ask_spell ("incomplete healing") if not spell then return end local per = ask_per (3, KIND[kd].item) if not per then return end local p = { id = data.next_id, cmd = c, kind = kd, spell = spell, nick = auto_nick (spell), per = per, total = 8, after = data.default_after, made = 0, tried = 0 } data.next_id = data.next_id + 1 data.profiles[#data.profiles + 1] = p register_aliases () save () note ("New profile " .. profile_line (p)) PnP_AlchCheck () end
local function busy (p) if run and run.p == p then warn ("Not while " .. nm (label (p)) .. " @x203is running - " .. hi ("pnp stop") .. " @x203first.") return true end return false end
-- =========================================================== -- The window -- Built like MazeMobber's list window: TextRect links run Lua; -- a link only schedules the work, so nothing happens inside the -- hotspot callback; zombie guard; scroll set after fit_contents; -- raised above the layout's invisible drag bar on every show. -- =========================================================== local WIN_ID = "PotAndPapers_win" local gWin = nil local win_gen = 0
local function win_line (segs) local styles, links, pos = {}, {}, 1 for _, sg in ipairs (segs) do if sg.text ~= "" then styles[#styles + 1] = { text = sg.text, textcolour = ColourNameToRGB (sg.colour or CLR_MSG) } if sg.code then links[#links + 1] = { start = pos, stop = pos + #sg.text - 1, text = sg.code, label = sg.tip } end pos = pos + #sg.text end end return styles, links end
function PnP_WinRaise () if gWin then pcall (WindowSetZOrder, WIN_ID, 99999) end end
function PnP_WinDestroy (tok) if tok and tok ~= win_gen then return end local w = gWin gWin = nil if w then pcall (function () w:delete (true) end) end pcall (WindowDelete, WIN_ID) pcall (Repaint) end
-- A link click: never act inside the window's own callback. function PnP_Click (action, id) PnP_After (0.1, string.format ("PnP_Do (%q, %d)", tostring (action), tonumber (id) or 0)) end
local function sp (n) return string.rep (" ", math.max (0, n)) end
local function win_lines () local L = {} local function add (segs) L[#L + 1] = segs end
add { { text = PNAME .. " v" .. VERSION .. " - click any value to change it", colour = CLR_NAME } } add { { text = " Bag ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = data.bag ~= "" and data.bag or "(not set - click)", colour = CLR_HI, code = 'PnP_Click("bag",0)', tip = "Bag the blanks come from and the finished ones go to" }, { text = " After, for new profiles ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = data.default_after ~= "" and data.default_after or "(nothing)", colour = CLR_NAME, code = 'PnP_Click("defafter",0)', tip = "The after command a new profile starts with" } } add { { text = " " } }
local wc, wn, ws, wa = #"Command", #"Name", #"Spell", #"After" for _, p in ipairs (data.profiles) do wc = math.max (wc, #p.cmd) wn = math.max (wn, #short_label (p)) ws = math.max (ws, #p.spell) wa = math.max (wa, #(p.after ~= "" and p.after or "-")) end wc, wn, ws, wa = wc + 2, wn + 2, ws + 2, wa + 2 add { { text = " Command" .. sp (wc - 7) .. "Name" .. sp (wn - 4) .. "Type Spell" .. sp (ws - 5) .. "Per Make After" .. sp (wa - 5) .. "Lifetime", colour = CLR_TAG } }
for _, p in ipairs (data.profiles) do local id = p.id local function c (a) return string.format ("PnP_Click(%q,%d)", a, id) end local k = kind (p) local lab = short_label (p) local after = p.after ~= "" and p.after or "-" local per = p.per .. "x" local tot = tostring (p.total) local life = string.format ("%d/%d %s", p.made, p.tried, pct (p.made, p.tried)) local mine = run and run.p == p add { { text = " " }, { text = p.cmd, colour = CLR_HI, code = c ("cmd"), tip = "Change the command" }, { text = sp (wc - #p.cmd) }, { text = lab, colour = CLR_NAME, code = c ("nick"), tip = "Change the nickname" }, { text = sp (wn - #lab) }, { text = k.label, colour = CLR_HI, code = c ("kind"), tip = "Switch between scribe and brew" }, { text = sp (8 - #k.label) }, { text = p.spell, colour = CLR_MSG, code = c ("spell"), tip = "Change the spell" }, { text = sp (ws - #p.spell) }, { text = per, colour = CLR_HI, code = c ("per"), tip = "Spells on each " .. k.item }, { text = sp (5 - #per) }, { text = tot, colour = CLR_HI, code = c ("total"), tip = "How many when no number is typed" }, { text = sp (6 - #tot) }, { text = after, colour = CLR_NAME, code = c ("after"), tip = "Run when the batch is done" }, { text = sp (wa - #after) }, { text = life, colour = CLR_MSG }, { text = sp (math.max (2, 18 - #life)) }, { text = mine and "[running]" or "[make]", colour = CLR_HI, code = (not mine) and c ("run") or nil, tip = "Make " .. p.total .. " now" }, { text = " " }, { text = "[delete]", colour = CLR_TAG, code = c ("del"), tip = "Delete this profile" }, } end if #data.profiles == 0 then add { { text = " (no profiles yet)", colour = CLR_TAG } } end
add { { text = " " } } add { { text = " " }, { text = "[new profile]", colour = CLR_HI, code = 'PnP_Click("new",0)', tip = "Add a profile" }, { text = " " }, { text = "[stop]", colour = run and CLR_HI or CLR_TAG, code = 'PnP_Click("stop",0)', tip = "Stop the batch (the after command is not run)" }, { text = " " }, { text = "[end session]", colour = (data.session and not run) and CLR_HI or CLR_TAG, code = 'PnP_Click("end",0)', tip = "Close the session now; the next batch starts a new one" } } add { { text = " " } }
if run then add { { text = " Batch ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = label (run.p) .. " " .. run.made .. "/" .. run.target .. " " .. pct (run.made, run.tried), colour = CLR_HI }, { text = string.format (" %d tried, this %s %d/%d spells", run.tried, run.k.item, run.spells, run.p.per), colour = CLR_MSG } } else local ex = data.profiles[1] and (data.profiles[1].cmd .. " 8") or "sinc 8" add { { text = " Batch ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = "idle - type a profile's command, e.g. " .. ex, colour = CLR_MSG } } end
local s = current_session () if s then add { { text = " Session ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = string.format ("%d made / %d tried %s", s.made, s.tried, pct (s.made, s.tried)), colour = CLR_HI }, { text = " since " .. os.date ("%H:%M", s.start) .. (run and "" or (", closes " .. os.date ("%H:%M", s.last + SESSION_GAP))), colour = CLR_MSG } } for _, e in ipairs (sorted_per (s)) do local l = tostring (e.label or e.cmd) add { { text = " " .. l .. sp (math.max (2, wn - #l)) .. string.format ("%d/%d %s", e.made, e.tried, pct (e.made, e.tried)), colour = CLR_MSG } } end else local h = data.history[1] if h then add { { text = " Last session ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = string.format ("%d made / %d tried %s", h.made, h.tried, pct (h.made, h.tried)), colour = CLR_HI }, { text = " " .. os.date ("%m/%d %H:%M", h.start) .. " to " .. os.date ("%H:%M", h.last), colour = CLR_MSG } } else add { { text = " Session ", colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = "none yet", colour = CLR_MSG } } end end return L end
local function win_open (keep_scroll) if type (ThemedTextWindow) ~= "function" then return false end win_gen = win_gen + 1 -- zombie guard: a handle the library has forgotten is never reused if gWin and not (ThemedWindowClass and ThemedWindowClass.window_map and ThemedWindowClass.window_map[WIN_ID]) then gWin = nil pcall (WindowDelete, WIN_ID) end if not gWin then local ok, w = pcall (ThemedTextWindow, WIN_ID, 386, 0, -- first-run left, top (it remembers where you drag it) 760, 300, -- width, height (fit_contents resizes it) PNAME, -- title "center", true, -- title-bar close button false, -- resizeable true, -- text scrolls false, false, false, true, -- autowrap data.font, data.fontsize, data.font, data.fontsize, 300, -- max lines nil, true, -- defer showing until drawn false, nil, "Close") if not ok or not w then return false end gWin = w if gWin.textrect and gWin.textrect.font_bold then gWin.textrect.font = gWin.textrect.font_bold end local prior = gWin.do_on_delete gWin.do_on_delete = function (self) if prior then prior (self) end gWin = nil end gWin.bring_to_front = function (self) PnP_WinRaise () end end
local keep = nil if keep_scroll and gWin.textrect then keep = tonumber (gWin.textrect.display_start_line) end gWin:clear (false) for _, segs in ipairs (win_lines ()) do local st, lk = win_line (segs) gWin:add_text (st, false, lk) end pcall (function () gWin:fit_contents (1200, data.winheight) end) -- the links start near the top: open at the top (or where it was) pcall (function () gWin:set_scroll (keep or 1) end) gWin:draw () gWin:show () PnP_WinRaise () pcall (Repaint) return true end
win_refresh = function () if gWin then win_open (true) end end
local function win_refont () if not gWin then return end win_gen = win_gen + 1 PnP_WinDestroy () win_open () end
-- =========================================================== -- Chat versions -- =========================================================== local function list_chat () note ("Profiles (bag " .. hi (data.bag ~= "" and data.bag or "not set") .. "):") for _, p in ipairs (data.profiles) do ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") Hyperlink (p.cmd, p.cmd, "Make " .. p.total, CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") ColourTell (CLR_NAME, "", label (p)) ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", string.format (" %dx %s, makes %d, then %s lifetime %d/%d %s", p.per, p.spell, p.total, p.after ~= "" and p.after or "nothing", p.made, p.tried, pct (p.made, p.tried))) end local s = current_session () if s then session_echo (s, "Session:") else note ("No session open.") end end
local function history_chat () if #data.history == 0 then note ("No closed sessions yet.") return end note ("Last sessions:") for i = 1, math.min (10, #data.history) do local h = data.history[i] cnote (string.format (" %s to %s %s made / %s tried %s", hi (os.date ("%m/%d %H:%M", h.start)), os.date ("%H:%M", h.last), hi (h.made), hi (h.tried), hi (pct (h.made, h.tried)))) end end
local function spells_chat () local added = {} for _, s in ipairs (data.spells) do added[s] = true end local t = {} for _, s in ipairs (all_spells ()) do t[#t + 1] = added[s] and hi (s) or esc (s) end note ("Spells on offer: " .. table.concat (t, ", ")) note ("Added by you in " .. hi ("green") .. ". " .. hi ("pnp spell add <name>") .. " / " .. hi ("pnp spell del <name>") .. ".") end
local HELP = { { "pnp config", "the profile window - click any value to change it" }, { "pnp add <cmd> <scribe|brew> <per> <make> <spell>", "new profile, e.g. pnp add sinc scribe 3 8 incomplete healing" }, { "pnp after <command|none>", "the after command new profiles start with (default sleep)" }, { "pnp bag <id>", "bag the blanks come from and the finished ones go to" }, { "pnp del <cmd>", "delete a profile (and its lifetime totals)" }, { "pnp end", "end the session now; the next batch starts a new one" }, { "pnp font [name]", "the window's font (no name: a picker)" }, { "pnp fontsize <n>", "the window's font size" }, { "pnp help", "this list" }, { "pnp history", "the last 10 closed sessions" }, { "pnp list", "profiles and the session, in chat" }, { "pnp reload", "load this plugin again after an update" }, { "pnp session", "the session so far" }, { "pnp set <cmd> <what> <value>", "what: cmd, nick, type, spell, per, make or after (after none = nothing)" }, { "pnp spell add <name>", "add a spell to the pick list" }, { "pnp spell del <name>", "take an added spell off the pick list" }, { "pnp spells", "the spells on the pick list" }, { "pnp stop", "stop the batch (the after command is not run)" }, { "pnp winheight <px>", "how tall the window may get" }, { "<profile cmd> [n]", "make n, or the profile's own number" }, } table.sort (HELP, function (a, b) return a[1] < b[1] end)
local function show_help () note (PNAME .. " " .. hi ("v" .. VERSION)) for _, h in ipairs (HELP) do cnote (" " .. hi (h[1]) .. sp (42 - #h[1]) .. esc (h[2])) end cnote (" A batch is one command; it ends when that many are MADE, then runs its after command.") cnote (" A session is every batch until an hour after the last spell; the session so far") cnote (" is echoed after 10 minutes with nothing new.") end
-- =========================================================== -- Clicks and commands -- =========================================================== function PnP_Do (action, id) local p = by_id (id) if action == "bag" then local v = utils.inputbox ("Bag (id or keyword) the blanks come from and the finished ones go to:", PNAME, data.bag) if v and trim (v) ~= "" then data.bag = trim (v) save () note ("Bag: " .. hi (data.bag) .. ".") end elseif action == "defafter" then local v = ask_after (data.default_after) if v then data.default_after = v save () note ("New profiles will run " .. (v ~= "" and hi (v) or "nothing") .. " after a batch.") end elseif action == "new" then new_profile () elseif action == "stop" then stop_batch () elseif action == "end" then end_session () return elseif p then if action == "run" then start_batch (p) return elseif action == "del" then if busy (p) then return end local r = utils.msgbox ("Delete the profile " .. label (p) .. " (" .. p.cmd .. ")?\n\n" .. "Its lifetime totals (" .. p.made .. " made of " .. p.tried .. ") go with it.", PNAME, "yesno", "?", 2) if r == "yes" then local _, i = by_id (id) table.remove (data.profiles, i) register_aliases () save () note ("Deleted " .. nm (label (p)) .. " (" .. hi (p.cmd) .. ").") end elseif action == "cmd" then local v = ask_cmd (p.cmd, p.id) if v then p.cmd = v; register_aliases (); save (); PnP_AlchCheck () end elseif action == "nick" then local v = ask_nick (p) if v then p.nick = v; save () end elseif action == "kind" then if busy (p) then return end p.kind = (p.kind == "brew") and "scribe" or "brew" save () note (nm (label (p)) .. " now " .. hi (kind (p).verb .. "s") .. ".") elseif action == "spell" then if busy (p) then return end local v = ask_spell (p.spell) if v then set_spell (p, v); save () end elseif action == "per" then if busy (p) then return end local v = ask_per (p.per, kind (p).item) if v then p.per = v; save () end elseif action == "total" then local v = ask_total (p.total, kind (p).items) if v then p.total = v; save () end elseif action == "after" then local v = ask_after (p.after) if v then p.after = v; save () end end end win_refresh () end
local function set_field (p, what, val) what = what:lower () if what == "cmd" or what == "command" then local c, err = check_cmd (val, p.id) if not c then warn (err) return end p.cmd = c register_aliases () PnP_AlchCheck () elseif what == "nick" or what == "name" then if trim (val) == "" then p.nick = auto_nick (p.spell) else local n, err = check_nick (val) if not n then warn (err) return end p.nick = n end elseif what == "type" or what == "kind" then if busy (p) then return end local v = trim (val):lower () if not KIND[v] then warn ("Type is " .. hi ("scribe") .. " @x203or " .. hi ("brew") .. "@x203.") return end p.kind = v elseif what == "spell" then if busy (p) then return end local s, err = check_spell (val) if not s then warn (err) return end set_spell (p, s) elseif what == "per" then if busy (p) then return end local n = tonumber ((val:gsub ("[xX]", ""))) if not n or n < 1 or n > 4 then warn ("Per is 1 to 4.") return end p.per = math.floor (n) elseif what == "make" or what == "total" then local n = tonumber (val) if not n or n < 1 or n > 999 then warn ("Make is 1 to 999.") return end p.total = math.floor (n) elseif what == "after" then local v = trim (val) if v:lower () == "none" then v = "" end p.after = v else warn ("I can set " .. hi ("cmd, nick, type, spell, per, make") .. " @x203or " .. hi ("after") .. "@x203.") return end save () note (profile_line (p)) win_refresh () end
function PnP_Command (name, line, w) local arg = trim (w[1]) local low = arg:lower ()
if low == "config" or low == "win" or low == "window" then if not win_open () then list_chat () end return end if low == "" or low == "help" then show_help () return end if low == "list" then list_chat () return end if low == "stop" then stop_batch () return end if low == "end" then end_session () return end if low == "history" then history_chat () return end if low == "spells" then spells_chat () return end if low == "session" then local s = current_session () if s then session_echo (s, "Session so far:") else note ("No session open.") end return end
if low == "reload" then if run then finish_batch ("stopped") end note ("Reloading " .. PNAME .. " (now " .. hi ("v" .. VERSION) .. ") from disk...") Execute (GetAlphaOption ("script_prefix") .. 'DoAfterSpecial(1, "ReloadPlugin(\'' .. GetPluginID () .. '\')", sendto.script)') return end
local da = arg:match ("^[Aa][Ff][Tt][Ee][Rr]%s*(.*)$") if da then da = trim (da) if da == "" then note ("New profiles run " .. (data.default_after ~= "" and hi (data.default_after) or "nothing") .. " after a batch. Change it with " .. hi ("pnp after <command>") .. " (or " .. hi ("pnp after none") .. ").") return end if da:lower () == "none" then da = "" end data.default_after = da save () note ("New profiles will run " .. (da ~= "" and hi (da) or "nothing") .. " after a batch. Existing profiles keep their own (" .. hi ("pnp set <cmd> after ...") .. ").") win_refresh () return end
local bag = arg:match ("^[Bb][Aa][Gg]%s+(.+)$") if bag then data.bag = trim (bag) save () note ("Bag: " .. hi (data.bag) .. ".") win_refresh () return end
local sa = arg:match ("^[Ss][Pp][Ee][Ll][Ll]%s+[Aa][Dd][Dd]%s+(.+)$") if sa then local s, err = check_spell (sa) if not s then warn (err) return end remember_spell (s) save () note ("Added " .. hi (s) .. " to the spell list.") return end local sd = arg:match ("^[Ss][Pp][Ee][Ll][Ll]%s+[Dd][Ee][Ll]%s+(.+)$") if sd then local s = trim (sd):lower () for i, k in ipairs (data.spells) do if k == s then table.remove (data.spells, i) save () note ("Took " .. hi (s) .. " off the spell list (profiles that use it keep it).") return end end warn ("'" .. esc (s) .. "' is not a spell you added (the built-in ones stay).") return end
local c, kd, per, make, spell = arg:match ("^[Aa][Dd][Dd]%s+(%S+)%s+(%a+)%s+(%S+)%s+(%d+)%s+(.+)$") if c then local cc, err = check_cmd (c, nil) if not cc then warn (err) return end kd = kd:lower () if not KIND[kd] then warn ("Type is " .. hi ("scribe") .. " @x203or " .. hi ("brew") .. "@x203.") return end local n = tonumber ((per:gsub ("[xX]", ""))) if not n or n < 1 or n > 4 then warn ("Per is 1 to 4.") return end local m = tonumber (make) if m < 1 or m > 999 then warn ("Make is 1 to 999.") return end local s, err2 = check_spell (spell) if not s then warn (err2) return end remember_spell (s) local p = { id = data.next_id, cmd = cc, kind = kd, spell = s, nick = auto_nick (s), per = math.floor (n), total = math.floor (m), after = data.default_after, made = 0, tried = 0 } data.next_id = data.next_id + 1 data.profiles[#data.profiles + 1] = p register_aliases () save () note ("New profile " .. profile_line (p)) PnP_AlchCheck () win_refresh () return end if low:match ("^add") then warn ("Use " .. hi ("pnp add <cmd> <scribe|brew> <per> <make> <spell>") .. "@x203, e.g. " .. hi ("pnp add sinc scribe 3 8 incomplete healing") .. "@x203.") return end
local dc = arg:match ("^[Dd][Ee][Ll]%s+(%S+)$") if dc then local p, i = by_cmd (dc) if not p then warn ("No profile " .. hi (dc) .. "@x203.") return end if busy (p) then return end table.remove (data.profiles, i) register_aliases () save () note ("Deleted " .. nm (label (p)) .. " (lifetime " .. p.made .. "/" .. p.tried .. ").") win_refresh () return end
local sc, what, val = arg:match ("^[Ss][Ee][Tt]%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s*(.*)$") if sc then local p = by_cmd (sc) if not p then warn ("No profile " .. hi (sc) .. "@x203.") return end set_field (p, what, val) return end
local wh = arg:match ("^[Ww][Ii][Nn][Hh][Ee][Ii][Gg][Hh][Tt]%s*(.*)$") if wh then local n = tonumber (wh) if not n or n < 200 or n > 1600 then warn ("Give a height from 200 to 1600 pixels. It is " .. data.winheight .. " now.") return end data.winheight = math.floor (n) save () note ("Window height: " .. hi (data.winheight) .. " pixels.") win_refont () return end
local fs = arg:match ("^[Ff][Oo][Nn][Tt][Ss][Ii][Zz][Ee]%s*(.*)$") if fs then local n = tonumber (fs) if not n or n < 6 or n > 40 then warn ("Give a size from 6 to 40. It is " .. data.fontsize .. " now.") return end data.fontsize = math.floor (n) save () note ("Window font: " .. hi (data.font .. " " .. data.fontsize) .. ".") win_refont () return end
local fn = arg:match ("^[Ff][Oo][Nn][Tt]%s*(.*)$") if fn then if fn == "" then local ok, f = pcall (utils.fontpicker, data.font, data.fontsize, 0) if not ok or not f then return end data.font = f.name or data.font data.fontsize = tonumber (f.size) or data.fontsize else data.font = fn end save () note ("Window font: " .. hi (data.font .. " " .. data.fontsize) .. ".") win_refont () return end
warn ("I do not know " .. hi (arg) .. "@x203. Type " .. hi ("pnp help") .. "@x203.") end
-- =========================================================== -- GMCP: whether you are asleep / fighting, and a moment to keep -- the window on top -- =========================================================== function OnPluginTelnetSubnegotiation (t, d) if t ~= 201 or type (d) ~= "string" then return end local pkg, body = d:match ("^([%w%._]+)%s+(.*)$") if pkg == "char.status" then local s = tonumber (body:match ('"state"%s*:%s*(%d+)')) if s then gstate = s end PnP_WinRaise () elseif pkg == "room.info" then PnP_WinRaise () end end
-- =========================================================== -- Install / teardown -- =========================================================== function OnPluginInstall () pcall (WindowDelete, WIN_ID) -- one left over from last session pcall (WindowDelete, "Scribe_win") -- the 1.0 name register_aliases () if session_expired () then close_session (true) elseif data.session then arm_session_timers (true) -- the hour carries on across a reload end local gd = GetPluginVariable (GMCP_ID, "gmcpdata") if gd and gd ~= "" then local ok, _, val = pcall (CallPlugin, GMCP_ID, "gmcpval", "char.status") if ok and type (val) == "string" then local s = tonumber (val:match ("state%W+(%d+)")) if s then gstate = s end end end note (hi ("v" .. VERSION) .. " loaded - " .. hi ("pnp config") .. " for the window, " .. hi ("pnp help") .. " for the rest.") PnP_After (3, "PnP_AlchCheck ()") end
function OnPluginClose () pcall (WindowDelete, WIN_ID) end
function OnPluginDisable () if run then run = nil EnableTriggerGroup ("pnp_scribe", false) EnableTriggerGroup ("pnp_brew", false) EnableTriggerGroup ("pnp_retry", false) end end
function OnPluginSaveState () save (true) end
